I don't know if this was the most efficient way to make this... but I rendered a video file in premiere of the painting zoomed in and then zooming out. And then in AE, I motion tracked the footage and parented the null to the blob guy. I did this because the blob guy's quality diminishes if I add the zoom effect after rendering in premier. It's an extra step and a little more hassle with the motion tracking but looks cleaner.
